description:
[read-only] Get a live flayr library track’s sections (intro, lift, drop, breakdown, ending), BPM, beat offset and full waveform, to choose a clip start and length that land on a beat or section. 404 when the track is not live.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/music/library/{id}/sections.)
name: music_library_sections
title: Get library track sections
